name: An Act to enact the Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act, to amend the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act and to make amendments to other Acts (Bill C-36)
owner: Parliament of Canada / Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada
description: Proposed Canadian federal private-sector privacy reform statute (45th Parliament, 1st Session, Bill C-36) enacting the Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act (PPCDA) and amending PIPEDA, establishing modernized consent, data portability, automated decision-making transparency, and privacy enforcement rules.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes federal statutory data protection, platform governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance obligations applicable to cloud-hosted services and digital platforms operating in Canada.
relationToAISecurity: Regulates AI systems, automated decision-making, and interactive AI chatbot/companion services accessible to Canadians.
